about: The still and clip prompt parts for BinLogic's Blueprint Reality look (style.md explains them). stills.py joins pre + the look's filled opening + tail, and refuses a prompt over max_chars.
pre: New image, unrelated to the previous ones:
opening_template: [Composition + camera], plan mode. Blueprint environment first: [3 to 5 named scene elements] rendered as a hand-drawn architectural blueprint illustration in two tones of blue ink on pale-blue blueprint grid paper (#EAF2FB) with a faint evenly spaced light-blue engineering grid, light sky-blue (#7CB6F2) flat fills with mid-blue (#1F6FD0) loose ink-pen line work, slight hand-drawn wobble, no grain, no floor shadows. [Photoreal hero subject + prop, fully colored, soft even daylight, slightly desaturated, realistic scale]. [Optional: a single vivid deep cyan-blue (#0B3D91) unbranded marker or focus ring on X, only if it earns its place]. Camera: [35/50/85mm], [height and angle], scene fills the frame edge to edge, the hero subject in the central third.
tail: Strict style separation: the hero subject is full-color photography; everything else is flat blue line illustration, no photoreal textures on walls, floor or background. Style: Blueprint Reality, mixed media combining real photography with hand-drawn blue blueprint illustration, modern logistics brand aesthetic. Format: 16:9 landscape, edge to edge, the hero subject in the central third so a vertical crop still holds it. Negative: no 3D render, no flat vector, no corporate stock photo, no watermarks, no gradient backgrounds, no halo border, no rounded corners, no invented logos or text, no letters inside the marker, no pure-white empty background, no doodles or sticky notes, no headline text, no recognizable real person, no real company logos.
clip_prompt: Static camera, no zoom, no pan. The blueprint drawing stays perfectly still, flat and hand-drawn; only this moves, slightly: {motion}. Keep every line, marker and color exactly as drawn. No new objects, no text, no logos, no change of style or color.
clip_negative: photoreal background, 3D render, morphing, warping lines, flicker, text, logos, new objects, camera shake
clip_default_motion: the hero subject shifts a little, as if caught in a light breeze
clip_note: Measured Nov 2026 with Kling 3.0 Turbo (720p, 5 s, 7.5 credits, about 4 minutes): the blueprint look held, but a 'camera push' prompt moved and reframed the whole scene and dropped the focus ring. The edit adds its own slow push, so the clip asks for a still camera.
